nodes.name: Solvothermal annealing on CNT sponge
nodes.procedure: Precursors were injected into bulk CNT sponges, which were then thermally annealed to form crystalline MoS2 sheets.
nodes.source_text: They used bulk CNT sponges... Precursors were injected into the sponge, and they were then thermally annealed in order to form crystalline sheets

nodes.name: MoS2 CVD on BNNT template
nodes.procedure: The BNNT film on a ceramic washer served as a template for MoS2 CVD, which resulted in a BNNT heteronotube with an SW-MoS2 NT (BNNT@MoS2 NT). MoS2 CVD was conducted at 530°C with precursors of sulfur (5g) and MoO3 powders (35mg). MoS2 grows in about 10 min at 530°C.
nodes.source_text: The BNNT film on a ceramic washer served as a template for MoS2 CVD... MoS2 CVD was conducted at 530°C with precursors of sulfur (5g) and MoO3 powders (35mg). MoS2 grows in about 10 min at 530°C.

nodes.name: Water droplet scrolling
nodes.procedure: A 100°C hot plate was placed on a CVD-grown 1L-MoS2 nanosheet. After application of a drop of DI water to the MoS2 nanosheet, it was pulled from one end to the other by a coverslip.
nodes.source_text: A 100°C hot plate was placed on a CVD-grown 1L-MoS2 nanosheet... A coverslip dragged an H2O droplet across an MoS2 film on an SiO2/Si at 3 mm s^-1

nodes.name: Evaporation-assisted heterojunction rolling
nodes.procedure: The bilayer film is rolled up into a heterojunction-NS structure via an evaporation-assisted assembly.
nodes.source_text: The bilayer film is rolled up into a heterojunction-NS structure via an evaporation-assisted assembly

nodes.name: Electrochemical exfoliation and heat treatment
nodes.procedure: Electrochemical exfoliation was used to generate large quantities of ultra-thin InSe nanosheets, which were then heat treated in order to form NSs.
nodes.source_text: First, electrochemical exfoliation was used to generate large quantities of ultra-thin InSe nanosheets, which were then heat treated

nodes.name: Acetone-assisted WS2 NS formation
nodes.procedure: Monolayer WS2 film grown by CVD forms triangular island on Si/SiO2 substrate. Acetone is dropped on top of the island to aid rolling from edges, then evaporated to form WS2 NSs.
nodes.source_text: The acetone is then dropped on top of the island in order to aid in rolling the film from the edges... it then evaporated, and WS2 NSs are finally formed

nodes.name: Ethanol droplet TMD NS scrolling
nodes.procedure: High-quality TMD NSs scrolled from CVD-grown 1L-MoS2 flakes in situ in 5 s using a single droplet of ethanol solution.
nodes.source_text: High-quality TMD NSs was scrolled from CVD-grown 1L-MoS2 flakes into high-quality NSs in situ in 5 s using a single droplet of an ethanol solution

nodes.name: Ionic gating WS2 NT superconductivity
nodes.procedure: Ionic gating in individual chiral NTs of WS2 enables superconductivity via electrochemical K+ intercalation using KClO4/PEG electrolyte.
nodes.source_text: Ionic gating in individual chiral NTs of WS2 enables this type of superconductivity. The gate medium used a KClO4/polyethylene glycol electrolyte

nodes.characterization_summary: PL from SW MoS2 NTs (6-7 nm diameter) on BNNTs confirms direct bandgap structure (DFT predicts transition from indirect to direct gap above ~5.2 nm diameter).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Photoluminescence (PL) from SW MoS2 NTs supported by core BNNTs is shown in this study. This shows that SW MoS2 NTs with a diameter of about 6 to 7 nm have a direct bandgap structure. The DFT studies show that when the diameter of an SW MoS2 NT exceeds ≈5.2 nm, it transitions from an indirect gap to a direct-gap semiconductor.
